in_marathi.name: Manthan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Churning the ocean of milk
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manthan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manthan refers to the mythological process of churning the ocean of milk to retrieve the Amrita or the elixir of immortality. This was a significant event in Hindu mythology involving the gods and demons working together.
